summary: Baileys fork with weak keyword-co-occurrence pattern match
details: The package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library. A single a static rule matched on keyword co-occurrence (the tokens 'ping' and 'GET' appearing in lib/Utils/generics.js), which in this library corresponds to normal WhatsApp protocol keep-alive/handshake handling and generic HTTP GET utilities rather than a network-exfiltration primitive. No traced code path was observed that reads installer-side secrets (environment variables, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles) or POSTs installer data to an attacker-controlled destination, and no install/import-time fetch-and-execute path is present. The evidence available is a weak pattern match without corroborating installer-harm signals.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
